clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Zargh sends a parcel of Barrens meat toward Orgrimmar. He asks young orc and troll adventurers to carry it to Devrak, the wind rider master, and learn the flight route to the Horde capital.

Wildlife fills the Barrens, from zhevras and plainstriders to kodos and thunder lizards. Zargh has prepared choice cuts for a personal delivery to Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. Rather than risk the long, dusty trek across the Southfury River into Durotar, he sends runners from the Crossroads to the wind rider perch.

Meeting Devrak gives a young Horde warrior a first look at the wind rider flight network. Wind rider masters connect remote outposts like the Crossroads to the Horde's fortified seat of power in Orgrimmar. Devrak prepares you and the cargo for a swift flight over the savannah.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have some choice cuts of meat that I want to send to a friend. Her name is Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar. Will you deliver the meat for me?
The fastest way to Orgrimmar is on a wind rider. Take the meats to the Crossroads wind rider master, Devrak, and speak with him about transport to Orgrimmar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You need to get somewhere fast? Then you're talking to the right traveler!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have to get this meat to Orgrimmar? That is no problem. For a small fee, my wind rider can take you there.
